messages:
lina: Heads-up — found weird behavior in Node sampleapp where X-Request-ID gets duplicated after auth retry (401 -> refresh -> retry). Seen in local structured logs and exported traces.
omar: which SDK version and a quick repro?
lina: sdk-node v0.10.2-rc, sampleapp. Repro by forcing token refresh. Example curl: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer BAD\" -H \"X-Request-ID: r-900\" http://localhost:8080/api/generate`
lina: observed: attempt1 logs `request_id=r-900`; attempt2 shows `request_id=r-900, request_id=r-900` in JSON. Tracing export shows both `http.request_id` and `http.request_id_1`.
dev-bot: note: retry header merge parity issue has cropped up before in older threads.
omar: sounds like retry layer concatenates header lists instead of using a single map. Python client reuses header map so not affected.
sre-bot: action suggestion: normalize OTEL attributes to keep the first seen request_id, add `retry_count`, and temporarily scrub `http.request_id_*` keys at ingestion.
lina: local quickfix: when merging retry headers do `const h = new Headers(orig); retry.forEach((v,k)=>h.set(k,v))` rather than concat/push semantics. Also consider initializing OTEL before retry middleware so one logical span wraps attempts.
omar: I'll open a PR with: header-preserve change, otel-normalize helper, and an integration test asserting only one X-Request-ID on the outgoing request (and spans contain single request_id). PR: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-node/pull/7412
support: please add a short blurb in sampleapp README / onboarding FAQ to help customers who hit this during the rollout.
lina: filed support ticket SUP-3182 to track incoming reports; note for testers: set LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG to reproduce — INFO often masks the duplicate-field printout.
marc: I can add a temporary Sentry scrub rule to drop keys matching `http.request_id_\d+` until the release.
omar: plan: (1) PR review & merge, (2) publish patch release, (3) infra scrub rule, (4) update docs + parity matrix.
lina: thanks — ping me for sample traces/test vectors if needed.
dev-bot: CI job 1024 on branch omar/fix-retry-headers passed ✅
